tasks.answer: The card says 'usually self-heals (12/13 past spells, typically ≤ 1 min) — not the 22 dead-lettered (no retries left).' My reading: it is a historical record of earlier failure spells of this class. 12 of 13 past spells cleared on their own, typically within a minute. That only applies to jobs that still have retries left and can retry themselves. It explicitly excludes dead-lettered jobs, which have no retries left. I would not lean on it for the current 22, because all 22 are dead-lettered and 'retrying' is 0. It is also only 13 samples, and the 13th spell did not heal. The other classes show 'no self-heal history', so this is the only class with a track record.

tasks.answer: I would act. Nothing is retrying, and the self-heal claim excludes dead-lettered jobs, so waiting will not clear these 22. I would retry the dead-lettered items, using the Retry group for demoSelfHealingBaseline. That covers 21 on Engine A and 1 on Engine B, both DEV engines (low stakes). I would leave alone any instance that has drained or still holds retries. The dialog says those are skipped: 'instances that drained or still hold retries are left alone'. The dialog says retry is 'Mostly safe: retrying only re-queues the step', and side effects of the step are not undone. I would give a reason of at least 10 characters. Caveat: the card says 'Requires OPERATOR on every engine in this group — missing on engine-a', so the Acknowledge button is disabled and my RESPONDER role may not be able to submit on Engine A. I did not test whether submitting would work, since I cancelled.
